CHANGEME
========

This is a [pyobs](https://www.pyobs.org) GUI for CHANGEME (one line: what it's for, who runs it).


System dependencies
--------------------
CHANGEME: Qt/PySide platform packages beyond what pip installs, if any. Delete this section if
there's none.


Install *pyobs-CHANGEME*
--------------------------
Clone the repository:

    git clone https://github.com/pyobs/pyobs-CHANGEME.git
    cd pyobs-CHANGEME

Install it with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

    uv sync


Running
-------
CHANGEME: the command to launch it and the minimal config it needs to connect to a fleet.
